feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because Boise Metal Works is a custom metal fabrication and manufacturing shop outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors.

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is outside ForgeX's target segment.

humanReview: Not applicable as no ForgeX automation is recommended; in any custom metal fabrication workflow, engineering design, material inspection, and custom job quoting require human estimator review.

risks.description: Custom metal fabrication and structural steel projects involve bespoke engineering specifications, tolerances, and building codes where automated quoting or AI-generated technical advice could cause fabrication errors.
Railing height, opening size, and stair rise dimensions are subject to residential and commercial building codes, requiring qualified human verification rather than automated guidance.
Customer-uploaded CAD drawings and proprietary product development files submitted through web forms may contain confidential commercial or industrial designs.

commercial.value: Illustrative only: $95/hour stated shop rate × 2 assumed hours of shop/estimator time per week = $190/week ($9,880/year). However, no ForgeX solution is recommended as the company is outside ForgeX's segment.
assumptions: Uses the site's stated shop rate of $95 per hour on https://www.boisemetalworks.com/metals-fabrication-industry-infomation/ ('Our shop rate is $95 an hour and is subject to change.').
Assumes an illustrative 2 hours per week of time valued at the $95/hour shop rate.
No ForgeX implementation is proposed because the business is not a fit for ForgeX's home-service contractor segment.

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identity, physical address, phone number, principal metal fabrication activities, web form presence, and technical script inspection.
Company founding history (1994) and co-founder names ([redacted] and [redacted]).
Service area verification (Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Caldwell, and Eastern Oregon) and contact form structure.
Published shop rate ($95/hour), materials handled, and residential/commercial code references.
Shop equipment capabilities, field/shop welding capabilities, and geometric nesting software usage.
Custom design and ornamental metal fabrication overview.
Water jet cutting capabilities, materials, and tolerances.

limitations: The website does not state current employee headcount.
The website names [redacted] and [redacted] as the 1994 founders, but does not explicitly confirm their current active executive or managerial titles.
The website does not disclose back-office accounting, ERP, or estimating software beyond mentioning geometric part-nesting software for the water jet machine.
The website does not display contractor license numbers or state registration numbers.
No evidence on the website indicates whether the company pays for leads.

qualification.rationale: ForgeX's target segment is owner-led home-service contractors in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical with about 10 to 75 staff who pay for leads. Boise Metal Works is a custom metal fabrication, machining, and water jet cutting shop serving commercial, industrial, and residential clients, placing it outside ForgeX's industry segment.
